simple.meaning: מַרְצֵעַ (martsêaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “an awl.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַרְצֵעַ (H4836) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 21:6, with occurrences in Exodus, Deuteronomy.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַרְצֵעַ (H4836) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַרְצֵעַ (H4836) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַרְצֵעַ (martsêaʻ) / H4836 is traced through Exodus 21:6, Deuteronomy 15:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

timeline.evidenceText: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.
then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also to your female servant you shall do likewise.
